requirement_snapshot.name: Notes List
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a notes area on the home page with the heading "Notes" listing notes from the database via a GET /api/notes endpoint. Each note row shows its title. An empty state says "No notes yet." when the table has no rows.

interfaces.name: App
interfaces.responsibility: Extends the Express app entry additively: imports notesRouter and mounts it at /api/notes without touching health route or SPA fallback.
interfaces.specification: app.use('/api/notes', notesRouter) registered before /api/health; existing routes and static/SPA serving preserved.
interfaces.test_focus: Supertest GET /api/notes returns 200 with notes payload through app instance

interfaces.name: NotesTable
interfaces.responsibility: Adds idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id, title, created_at) inside initializeDatabase so the schema exists at every startup/reset.
interfaces.specification: notes table: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT datetime('now'); created idempotently in startInit.
interfaces.test_focus: Harness DB contains notes table with required columns; empty table drives 'No notes yet.'

interfaces.name: SeedDb
interfaces.responsibility: Seeds deterministic idempotent notes rows via INSERT OR IGNORE (ids 1-3) inside the existing seed transaction so the list scenario has DB data after startup.
interfaces.specification: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notes (id, title) VALUES (1,'Welcome to Notes'),(2,'Buy groceries'),(3,'Call the dentist'); repeated seeding is safe and non-duplicating.
outputs: three persisted note rows with fixed ids/titles
interfaces.test_focus: After seedDefault, GET /api/notes returns exactly these titles; re-seed keeps row count stable

interfaces.name: Notes
interfaces.responsibility: Owns GET /api/notes handler: returns {code:200,message:'OK',data:Note[]} from the service, 500 {code:'INTERNAL_ERROR'} on failure.
interfaces.specification: GET /api/notes -> 200 {code, message, data: [{id,title,createdAt},...]}; empty table yields data: []; failure -> 500 {code:'INTERNAL_ERROR', message:'Failed to load notes'}.
interfaces.test_focus: Supertest: seeded DB returns titles; empty DB returns []; error path returns 500 with INTERNAL_ERROR

interfaces.name: NotesService
interfaces.responsibility: Owns notes persistence queries: listNotes selects all notes ordered by id with created_at aliased as createdAt via the shared db_runtime.
interfaces.specification: listNotes() -> Promise<Array<{id:number,title:string,createdAt:string}>> ordered by id ASC using SELECT id, title, created_at AS createdAt FROM notes.
outputs: ordered note rows from the notes table
interfaces.test_focus: Unit test against harness DB: returns rows in insertion order; empty table returns []

interfaces.name: Notes
interfaces.responsibility: Owns the frontend API boundary for notes: exports Note type and fetchNotes() calling GET /api/notes through the shared axios client.
interfaces.specification: fetchNotes(): Promise<Note[]> issues apiClient.get('/notes') and returns response.data.data; Note = {id:number,title:string,createdAt:string}.
outputs: Promise resolving to Note[] from the API
interfaces.test_focus: Mocked apiClient returns {code:200,data:[...]}; fetchNotes maps to Note[] and rejects on error

interfaces.name: NotesPanel
interfaces.responsibility: Owns the visible notes area: heading 'Notes', one row per note title, and the 'No notes yet.' empty state with loading/error states.
interfaces.specification: section with heading 'Notes' (exact literal); empty list renders 'No notes yet.'; renders each note.title as a list row; loading shows 'Loading notes...'; error shows alert message.
outputs: notes area DOM per data state
interfaces.test_focus: getByRole('heading',{name:'Notes'}); notes titles visible; 'No notes yet.' shown for empty data; error/loading states rendered

interfaces.name: NOTES_LOAD_ERROR
interfaces.responsibility: Owns notes load state: fetches on mount via fetchNotes, exposing notes, loading, error, reload with the stable NOTES_LOAD_ERROR message.
interfaces.specification: useNotes(): {notes:Note[], loading:boolean, error:string|null, reload:()=>void}; loads on mount; on failure error = "Couldn't load notes." (exported NOTES_LOAD_ERROR).
interfaces.test_focus: Render-hook test: resolves notes on success; sets NOTES_LOAD_ERROR on rejection; reload refetches

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Mounts NotesPanel inside the existing home page container so the notes area renders on '/' without restructuring the page shell.
interfaces.specification: HomePage renders <NotesPanel /> inside the max-w-7xl page container; existing shell classes preserved.
interfaces.test_focus: Rendering HomePage shows NotesPanel; '/'-level UI test sees the notes section
